method: Drafted from granite-docling output, then each page read against its image (pdftoppm -r 110) and every word where the draft and the PDF text layer disagree re-read at the image; footnote markers as [^n], notes in <label>.notes.txt; a note that begins on the page before keeps its label (the page holds only its tail). Not a second independent transcription: see docs/design/2026-10-03-vision-structure-pass.md for the limits.
label: the page's %%page N%% label in full.md: the printed number, with #2 for a repeated one. Files are named by PDF page, not label (labels are not file names): a loader must map through pages[pdf].label
sample: random: seeded shuffle (random.seed(20261003)) over body pages 12-169 not in golden.yaml; golden: pages golden.yaml already verifies (the pipeline was tuned on them)
